name: chandra_flames_catalyst_minus_two_pays_with_an_untapped_mountain
notes: Printed: '[-2]: You may cast target red instant or sorcery card from your graveyard.' The spell cast as the -2 resolves is paid like any cast: its controller may activate mana abilities while paying (CR 601.2g, 605.3a), so an untapped Mountain pays Shock's {R}: the -2 is offered with Shock its target, the Mountain taps, Shock kills the Bear and is exiled. An engine fault until engine wave E3 (found by mapper wave 5, 2026-11-18; a known-bugs pack then): the effect-cast lane priced and paid from the mana pool only (query._cast_option_payable and stack.cast_card read legality.build_payment_plan alone), and the menu clamped the -2's target to cards the pool could pay for, so with the mana in a land the -2 was not offered (fails on main fa284327). In a dealt game no mana floats (a mana ability is no menu row), so the -2 was never usable.
